name: Parameterized Backup
description: Reusable backup workflow — run against any source/destination pair using --param.

source_file.description: Path to the file to back up (e.g. data/report.json)

backup_file.description: Destination path for the backup copy (e.g. backups/report_backup.json)

label.description: Human-readable label recorded in the summary

max_retries.description: Number of retry attempts if the copy step fails

tasks.description: Verify the {{ label }} copy is readable
